title: Home practical guide and safety card: metal or non-metal
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: The periodic table (8F); breathing and respiration (8C)
source: Written for science/y8 lesson 26 (Home practical guide and safety card: metal or non-metal (portal worksheet; tap gently, no sharp items))
intro: Lesson 26: Physical properties of metals and non-metals. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To sort materials into metals and non-metals
equipment: Objects: a spoon, a coin, a pencil, a plastic ruler, foil, a wooden block
A torch, two wires and a cell if you have a kit
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Look at each object: is it shiny?
Tap it gently: does it ring?
Try to bend it gently (no sharp items)
Test with the circuit if you have one: does it conduct?

questions.q: Big question: why are saucepan handles not metal?
questions.a: Metals conduct heat well; non-metal handles are insulators and stay cool.
